durabilitynotifier.config.title: Durability Notifier Config
durabilitynotifier.configuration.CheckAr: Dictates if it should also actively check armor [default: false]
durabilitynotifier.configuration.Percent: Sets the percentage the mod checks for [default: 10] (1 to 100)
durabilitynotifier.configuration.PlaySou: Change this option to let it play a sound (configurable in the sound tab) [default: false]
durabilitynotifier.configuration.SendMes: Change this option to let it not display a chat message (if you have sound enabled) [default: true]
durabilitynotifier.configuration.SentMes: Change this option to change the color / formatting of the message (if you have messages enabled) [default: YELLOW]
durabilitynotifier.configuration.soundlo: The id of the sound that is played (if you have sound enabled) [default: minecraft:block.note_block.pling]
